Name: Don't Disturb
Author: coolsp0t
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/headers/24742_1717189630.jpg[/img]
[size=4]A simple to use Sound Menu to disable ingame sounds on demand like doors, the sellbox or specified animals.[/size][/center]

[center][spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542889-1489279570.png[/img][/spoiler][/center]

[b][u]How to install -LITE- Version:[/u][/b]
[color=#ea9999][b]With -LITE- Version needs the Game be restarted before a sound is activated again![/b][/color]
- install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
- install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
- Download Don't Disturb -LITE- & unzip the content of the 7Zip file into your stardew valley game folder "..\Stardew Valley\mods"
[b]Example:[/b] c:\steam\steamapps\common\stardew valley\mods
The Installation was successfully when the Mod shows up in the Menu Config.
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542751-336218738.png[/img][/spoiler]

[b][u]How to install -FULL- Version:[/u][/b]
- [b]Get sure you have successfully installed Don't Disturb -LITE- Version.[/b]
- Download Don't Disturb -Installer- & unzip the content of the 7Zip file into your stardew valley game folder "..\Stardew Valley\mods"
[b]Example:[/b] c:\steam\steamapps\common\stardew valley\mods
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542920-535001386.png[/img][/spoiler]
-> [b]unxwb.exe: soundfile extractor[/b]
- Download [b]unxwb.exe by Luigi Auriemma[/b] & place it in [b]"..\Stardew Valley\mods\[CP] Don't Disturb\install"[/b]
-> Stardew Wiki: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Unpack_audio_files]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Unpack_audio_files[/url]
-> GIT Directlink: [url=https://github.com/mariodon/unxwb/raw/master/unxwb.exe]https://github.com/mariodon/unxwb/raw/master/unxwb.exe[/url]

-> [b]ffmpeg.exe: Audio & Video converter[/b]
- Download [b]ffmpeg.exe[/b] & place it in [b]"..\Stardew Valley\mods\[CP] Don't Disturb\install" [/b]
-> GIT Mirror: [url=https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-git-full.7z]https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-git-full.7z[/url]
-> Open [b]ffmpeg-git-full.7z[/b] and extract [b]"ffmpeg-2024-05-29-git-fa3b153cb1-full_build\bin\ffmpeg.exe"[/b]
After this step looks the install folder like this:
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542924-250440617.png[/img][/spoiler]
- Execute [b]start_install.bat[/b]
- When you have confirmed the installation did the script start.
- The Batch Script will extract & encode the needed files for you.
- [b]Delete[/b] the [b]"install" folder.[/b] (optional)
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542920-1204687610.png[/img][/spoiler]
The Installation was successfully when the Mod shows up in the Menu Config.
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24742/24742-1717542576-2114112488.png[/img][/spoiler]
[u][b]-Full- Version Note:[/b][/u]
Depending on the loading speed of your computer needs the change a short moment till it shows an effect.
When you freeze the time with CJB Cheats Menu has an Option Switch no effect till the time keeps running again.

[b][u]Why does the Full Version need an Installer?[/u][/b]
[spoiler]During development of the Mod did I really try to find a way to get access to the soundfiles of the game without unpacking them, but this is actually with content patcher not possible. Then I guessed its ok when I deliver the soundfiles encoded in OGG within the Mod package, but Im not a new modder and know that this is not the correct way to do that. The correct way is to extract & encode the soundfiles by the Mod User. As to write a big tutorial on how to extract & encode the soundfiles did I decide to wrote a small installer which performs this action. The reason why I dont pack unxwb & ffmpeg with the package is nearly the same as to deliver the soundfiles. Both applications aren't made by me and I also dont want that my installer has to perform a download for security reasons.[/spoiler]

Have fun!

cOOLsp0T
